title: Free Banking with Tokenized Money
title_zh: DP21785 代币化货币下的自由银行体系
authors: Hans Gersbach, Sebastian Zelzner
official: 官方在线 2026-07-23 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: We study free banking with tokenized money and ask whether competition among private issuers can deliver efficient allocations in rollover economies with and without financial frictions. Issuers finance long-term investments by issuing par-redeemable, bearer-like tokens that must be rolled over at an intermediate date. In frictionless environments, Bertrand competition can implement the first-best, but the rollover channel depends on the competitive margin: competition in yields supports active secondary trade, whereas competition in issuance discounts forces issuer-managed rollover. When some issuers secretly abscond with funds, revealed absconding triggers default and exit, concentrating savings on surviving issuers and lowering aggregate rollover needs. This funds-concentration effect shifts equilibrium refinancing rates and redistributes returns across cohorts, so even investors who enter only after misconduct is revealed bear part of its consequences. Finally, we provide a new perspective on how regulatory restrictions on token remuneration can create inefficiency, instability, and potentially market breakdown.
abstract_zh: 本文研究代币化货币下的自由银行体系，探讨在存在与不存在金融摩擦的展期经济中，私人发行者之间的竞争能否实现有效配置。发行者通过发行以面值赎回、类似不记名形式的代币来为长期投资融资，这些代币必须在中间日期进行展期。在无摩擦环境中，伯特兰竞争可以实现最优配置，但展期渠道取决于竞争维度：收益率竞争支持活跃的二级市场交易，而发行折扣竞争则迫使发行者主导展期。当部分发行者秘密携款潜逃时，暴露的潜逃行为会引发违约和退出，从而将储蓄集中于幸存发行者，降低总体展期需求。这种资金集中效应会改变均衡再融资利率，并在不同代际间重新分配收益，因此即使在不当行为暴露后才进入市场的投资者也需承担部分后果。最后，本文为代币报酬的监管限制如何导致效率低下、不稳定乃至潜在市场崩溃提供了全新视角。

title: On the Effects of Monetary Policy Shocks on Income and Consumption Heterogeneity

abstract: We use the functional autoregressive framework of Chang, Chen, and Schorfheide (2024) to examine the effects of monetary policy shocks on the cross-sectional distributions of U.S. earnings, consumption, and financial income. An expansionary shock reduces earnings inequality, primarily by moving individuals out of unemployment, increases consumption inequality, mainly through spending on durable goods, and raises financial income inequality. We further show how an internal instrument can be used to identify the central bank’s reaction function within a VAR framework.

title: Assessing Macrofinancial Linkages in China Using a Machine-Learned Parsimonious VAR Model
title_zh: 基于机器学习简约VAR模型的中国宏观金融关联性评估
authors: Jin-Chuan Duan & Mr. Dimitrios Laliotis & Ms. Wei Sun
official: 官方在线 2026-06-26 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines macrofinancial linkages between property developers, financial institutions, and macroeconomic outcomes in China. Using a parsimonious vector autoregressive (VAR) model enabled by a machine learning algorithm, it quantifies how idiosyncratic shocks can propagate and be amplified across sectors, with potential implications for financial stability. Stress originating from privately owned developers and regionally focused financial institutions—though relatively limited in scale—can generate persistent spillovers through lending relationships, common exposures, shared markets, and changes in market sentiment. A decline in property prices may undermine investment, weaken consumer confidence, and adversely affect the health of both the property and financial sectors, thereby disrupting financial intermediation and weighing on broader economic growth. Policy considerations should take into account these feedback loops. Market- and exposure-based tools can be helpful for monitoring macrofinancial linkages and assessing the transmission of shocks.
abstract_zh: 本文考察了中国房地产开发商、金融机构与宏观经济结果之间的宏观金融关联。借助机器学习算法构建的简约向量自回归（VAR）模型，本文量化了异质性冲击如何通过部门间传导与放大，并对金融稳定产生潜在影响。源自私营开发商及区域性金融机构的压力——尽管规模相对有限——可通过信贷关系、共同风险敞口、共享市场及市场情绪变化，产生持续性的溢出效应。房价下跌可能削弱投资、打击消费者信心，并对房地产与金融部门的健康状况造成不利影响，进而扰乱金融中介功能，拖累整体经济增长。政策制定需充分考虑这些反馈循环。基于市场与风险敞口的工具，有助于监测宏观金融关联并评估冲击传导机制。

title: Trade Diversion and Jobs: Evidence from Mexican Municipalities
title_zh: 贸易转移与就业：来自墨西哥城市的证据
authors: Rodríguez-Castelán, Carlos, Vazquez, Emmanuel, Winkler, Hernan
source: World Bank Policy Research Working Papers
official: 官方在线 2026-06-29 · 来源：出版社网页
abstract: This paper examines the local effects of the 2018–19 U.S.-China trade disruptions on Mexico. Combining detailed municipal-level customs data with U.S. tariff schedules, it estimates that municipalities with greater export concentration in products targeted by U.S. tariffs on China (hereafter, tariff exposure) experienced significantly larger nearshoring dividends. An increase of 1 percent in tariff exposure led to a 4.3 percent increase in municipality-level exports to the United States, with gains concentrated in northern and south-central states. These export gains translated into broad labor market improvements: total labor income rose by 5.6 percent for each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure, driven by job creation rather than wage growth as average earnings remained unchanged. The effects were heterogeneous across skill levels, with the largest employment rate gains among semi-skilled workers. Beyond job quantity, the shock improved job quality: each 1 percent increase in tariff exposure reduced labor informality by 0.25 percentage points, with newly created jobs disproportionately being formal. Effects were driven primarily by manufacturing but extended to services through local spillovers. The findings indicate that trade policy changes between major economies can significantly reshape the spatial distribution of economic activity and the quantity and quality of jobs in third-party countries.
abstract_zh: 本文研究了2018-2019年中美贸易摩擦对墨西哥的本地影响。通过将市级海关数据与美国关税清单相结合，本文估算发现，在美国对华加征关税所针对的产品中（以下简称关税暴露度），出口集中度越高的城市，其获得的近岸外包红利显著更大。关税暴露度每增加1%，城市对美出口额增长4.3%，且增长集中在北部和中南部各州。这些出口增长转化为广泛的劳动力市场改善：关税暴露度每增加1%，劳动总收入增长5.6%，这一增长由就业创造驱动而非工资上涨，因为平均收入保持不变。不同技能水平的影响存在异质性，半熟练工人的就业率增幅最大。除就业数量外，冲击还提升了就业质量：关税暴露度每增加1%，非正规就业比例下降0.25个百分点，且新增就业岗位中正规就业占比显著更高。影响主要来自制造业，但通过本地溢出效应延伸至服务业。研究结果表明，主要经济体之间的贸易政策变化能够显著重塑第三方国家的经济活动空间分布以及就业数量与质量。

title: Fiscal sustainability in the world economy: evidence from panel and time-series analysis of 38 countries over half a century
title_zh: 世界经济中的财政可持续性：基于38个国家半个世纪面板与时间序列分析的证据
authors: Ricardo Ferraz
abstract: Fiscal sustainability, closely linked to government solvency, is essential for public financing and, consequently, for ensuring the normal functioning of economic activity. In the context of rising global debt levels and higher borrowing costs, as recently highlighted by the International Monetary Fund, this paper examines the sustainability of fiscal policy across the world economy using a combination of estimation methods and tests. Adopting an approach that integrates panel data with time-series analysis for a sample of 38 countries over the past half-century, the initial conclusion is that global fiscal policy has been sustainable. However, a country-by-country analysis reveals a more nuanced reality. According to the ranking proposed in this paper, slightly more than two-thirds of the countries can be classified as exhibiting either unsustainable fiscal policies (Level C) or partial sustainability with potential risks (Level B) over the 1974–2023 period. The remainder of the sample shows evidence of fiscal sustainability (Level A); however, even within this level, the strength of this relationship varies considerably across countries, highlighting substantial heterogeneity in fiscal sustainability. By providing a comprehensive cross-country assessment based on a relatively long time series using rigorous applied techniques, this paper offers timely and policy-relevant insights for both academics and policymakers.
abstract_zh: 财政可持续性与政府偿付能力密切相关，是公共融资的基础，进而保障经济活动的正常运转。在全球债务水平攀升、借贷成本上升的背景下（国际货币基金组织近期已强调此问题），本文综合运用多种估计方法与检验手段，考察全球经济体的财政政策可持续性。通过将面板数据与时间序列分析相结合，对过去半个世纪38个国家的样本进行研究，初步结论显示全球财政政策总体具有可持续性。然而，国别分析揭示了更为复杂的现实。根据本文提出的分级体系，在1974-2023年期间，略超三分之二的国家可归类为不可持续的财政政策（C级）或存在潜在风险的局部可持续性（B级）。其余样本国家呈现财政可持续性证据（A级），但即便在这一层级内，各国可持续性关系的强度也存在显著差异，凸显财政可持续性的高度异质性。本文基于较长时序数据，运用严谨的应用技术方法提供全面的跨国评估，为学术界和政策制定者提供了具有时效性和政策参考价值的洞见。

title: The inefficiency of moderate political coercion: a cross-country comparison of coercion intensity, state legitimacy, and regime stability
title_zh: 温和政治胁迫的低效性：胁迫强度、国家合法性与政权稳定性的跨国比较
authors: Øivind Schøyen, Espen Sirnes, Chris Rune Andersen
abstract: Political coercion directed against non-state moralities can serve as a tool for generating legitimacy. Does the efficacy of political coercion in producing legitimacy vary with its intensity? Using Freedom House, V-Dem, and Polity5 indices as proxies for coercive intensity, together with data on regime legitimacy and survival, we find that a mid-level range of coercion is ineffective in generating legitimacy. Relatively few regimes operate in this intermediate zone, and those that do exhibit lower legitimacy and higher instability risks. In contrast, shifts away from this suboptimal range-toward either higher or lower coercion levels-correlate significantly with gains in legitimacy. Time-series analysis of authoritarian regimes reveals a recurring pattern: gradual reductions in coercion that drift into this inefficient mid-range, followed by sharp increases. This dynamic suggests that coercion carries substantial exogenous costs such as economic and reputational costs and that delayed feedback on its legitimacy effects produces overshooting. Drawing on historical cases such as the USSR, we argue that moderate coercion proves inefficient due to an intrinsic negative reaction to coercion, or coercion resentment.
abstract_zh: 针对非国家道德的政治强制可成为合法性生成的工具。政治强制在产生合法性方面的效力是否会随其强度变化？通过使用自由之家、V-Dem和Polity5指数作为强制强度的代理变量，结合政权合法性与存续数据，我们发现中等强度的强制区间无法有效生成合法性。相对较少的政权处于这一中间地带，而处于该区间的政权表现出较低的合法性和较高的不稳定风险。相反，偏离这一次优区间——无论是向更高还是更低强制水平移动——与合法性提升显著相关。对威权政权的时间序列分析揭示了一种反复出现的模式：逐步降低强制力度会滑入这一低效的中间区间，随后出现急剧的强制升级。这一动态表明，强制会带来显著的外生成本（如经济成本和声誉成本），而对其合法性效应的延迟反馈会导致过度调整。借鉴苏联等历史案例，我们认为，由于强制会引发内在的负面反应（即强制怨恨），温和的强制被证明是低效的。

title: How judges’ social identity impacts reversal decisions: evidence from the transitory promotion of judges
title_zh: 法官社会身份对改判决策的影响：基于法官临时晋升的证据
authors: Patrick C Wu, Chang-Ching Lin, Yun-chien Chang
abstract: Several studies have underscored the significance of familiarity and collegiality in shaping judicial behavior in US federal courts. However, the distinct features of the US judicial system limit the ability to formulate a general theory. This research draws on 84,335 appellate decisions from Taiwanese courts to examine the role of familiarity in a career judge system. In Taiwan, lower court judges are transitorily promoted to appellate courts for 3 years, after which they typically return to their district courts before some of them are permanently promoted. By comparing their reversal patterns during temporary and subsequent permanent promotions to those of permanent appellate judges, we find that transitorily promoted judges reverse less frequently, and judges generally favor district courts where they have previously served. Social identity is likely a key explanatory factor. The size, diversity, and random allocation of cases in our dataset strengthens the generality of judicial behavior theories.
abstract_zh: 多项研究强调了熟悉度与同僚关系在美国联邦法院司法行为中的重要性。然而，美国司法体系的独特性限制了构建普适性理论的能力。本研究基于台湾法院的84,335份上诉判决，探讨职业法官体系中熟悉度的作用。在台湾，地方法院法官会临时晋升至上诉法院任职三年，之后通常返回原审法院，其中部分法官最终获得永久晋升。通过比较这些法官在临时晋升与后续永久晋升期间与常任上诉法官的改判模式，我们发现：临时晋升法官的改判频率较低，且法官普遍倾向于偏袒其曾任职的地方法院。社会认同可能是关键解释因素。本数据集在规模、多样性及案件随机分配方面的优势，增强了司法行为理论的普适性。

title: Information disclosure and questionnaires in public tenders
title_zh: 公开招标中的信息披露与问卷调查
authors: Thomas Greve, Hans Keiding
abstract: Public tenders typically involve uncertainty and unforeseen costs, which might not be fully known to the bidders themselves. This uncertainty may also concern adaptation costs to the procurer after the delivery, and information about such adaptation costs may influence the bidding strategies, even though the cost is paid by the procurer. Consequently, the availability of information matters, and if it is obtained by the procurer, withholding information from bidders may be better than sharing all of it. To investigate the methods of gathering information, we consider pre‐qualification stage questionnaires designed to obtain information from the bidders. If suitably designed, they can be used to disclose information of which the bidders are themselves unaware and can thereby serve as a tool for revealing the inherent tendency of the cost for the bidders, so that the unforeseen future cost can be estimated.
abstract_zh: 公开招标通常涉及不确定性和不可预见的成本，投标人自身可能无法完全了解这些成本。这种不确定性还可能涉及交付后采购方的适应成本，尽管该成本由采购方承担，但有关此类适应成本的信息仍可能影响投标策略。因此，信息的可获得性至关重要。若采购方掌握了信息，对投标人隐瞒信息可能比完全共享更优。为探究信息收集方法，我们考虑在资格预审阶段设计问卷，以获取投标人的信息。若设计得当，此类问卷可用于披露投标人自身尚未意识到的信息，从而成为揭示投标人成本内在趋势的工具，进而对不可预见的未来成本进行估算。
